Md Abdun Nur, Advocate-on-Record — For the Petitioners.

Bangladesh Water Development Board & others ------ Petitioners
vs
Md Quamruzzaman ------ Respondent
full_judgment:
2. The respondent filed the above writ petition stating that by Memo dated 24-12-1977 he was appointed as an Upper Division Assistant in the Board of Trustees, Directorate of Finance, Bangladesh Water Development Board (BWDB) and he joined there on 26-12-1977 and on recognition of his honesty and efficiency he on 4-10-1995 was promoted as Accountant and on 4-11-2002 was promoted to the post of Accounts Officer; according to the provisions of Chapter XV the Benevolent Fund and Group Insurance of the Bangladesh Water Development Board (Employees) Service Rules, 1982, the above Board of Trustee has got separate identity and is not connected and attached with other provisions of the Rules 1982 as this Chapter shall apply only to all regular employees of the Board of Trustee in respect of Provident Fund, Gratuity or other benefits accruing to them after retirement or invalidation and in spite of having such provisions, the Deputy Secretary (Board), BWDB, the respondent No. 4, passed order vide Memo dated 3-3-1983 to the effect that the officers and staffs of the Board of Trustee would remain attached with the Directorate of Finance, BWDB and will be encoder in the Finance and Accounts Cadre of BWDB then one Ahmed Hossain (since deceased), who was an Upper Division Assistant of the Board of Trustee instituted Title Suit No. 857 of 1985 before the 4th Court of Munsif (now Assistant Judge), Dhaka seeking declaration that the above Memo dated 3-3-83 is illegal and not binding upon him and on 8-2-1987 the above suit was decreed in his favour in view of which the respondent No-4, by order dated 4-10-87, cancelled the above Memo dated 3-3-83 but again, by Memo dated 28-4-2004 the respondent No. 4 ordered that in terms of Circular dated 24-9-88 issued by the Secretary, Ministry of Bangladesh Water Development, the officers and staffs of the Trustee Board will be treated as Finance and Accounts Audit Cadre under the Directorate of Finance of BWDB. Thereafter BWDB issued Circular dated 27-1-2000 approving the "সংশোুধত পদায়ন" of all the officers and staffs of BWDB in terms of the পরিশিষ্ট holding that Board of Trustees of BWDB is a separate entity under the Government and Autonomous Body Employees Benevolent Fund and Group Insurance Ordinance 1982. 

 6. As it appears the High Court Division made the Rule absolute holding that the impugned order dated 28-4-2004 has been challenged by the writ petitioner on the ground that the officers and the staffs of the Board of Trustees cannot be treated as Finance Accounts and Audit Cadre under the Directorate of Finance of BWDB because the Board of Trustees has been created as per provisions of section 4 of the Government and Autonomous Body Corporation Employees Benevolent Fund and Group Insurance Ordinance 1982 and it has been given a separate entity and by dint of above Statute and so the employees of Board of Trustees have got their separate identity and cannot be considered as employees of অহিনি Finance and Audit Accounts Cadre, and that before issuance of the impugned order dated 28-4-2004, similar order dated 3-3-1983 was issued by the respondent No. 4 and then Ahmed Hossain (since deceased) filed Title Suit No. 857 of 1985 seeking declaration that above order of amalgamation is illegal and the above suit was decreed declaring that the said order dated 3-3-83 as illegal and void and on the basis of the said decree the respondent No. 4, vide Memo dated 4-10-87, cancelled the earlier order dated 3-3-83 withdrawing the amalgamation but again, on the self some matter, the respondent No. 4 issued the order dated 28-4-2004 disregarding the earlier verdict of the civil Court which manifestly being illegal and without any lawful authority, is liable to be struck down.
